author: D. R. Moore, 1977

note.en: A nut clam under 2 mm, from reef sand at Punta Cahuita; a museum sample only.
note.es: Una almeja nuez de menos de 2 mm, de arena arrecifal en Punta Cahuita; solo una muestra de museo.

evidence: GBIF: 1 record(s) in the region, mostly museum specimens (Universidad de Costa Rica collections)

sources.t: Espinosa & Ortea 2001, Moluscos del mar Caribe de Costa Rica (REGAMA and Cahuita catalogue), Avicennia

marks.en: Small, rounded-triangular nutclam shell with a pearly inside and a finely toothed hinge.
marks.es: Concha pequeña, redondeada y casi triangular, de interior nacarado y charnela finamente dentada.
